entries.what: Section 2: Joel's own rewrite of the paragraph on what communal ownership needs (2026-10-01 14:49), with one spelling fix, "leaching" to "leeching" [in the section 2 v3 candidate]
entries.joel: Communal ownership entails folks taking on visible and named stewardship duties. It requires knowing what to do if someone is leaching off the group and how to deal with it. It requires developing healthier forms of relationships. No, taking away the idea of a boss does not make everyone less passive, selfish, steal less, or try to act helpless.

entries.what: Section 3, P6: Joel's human pass (2026-10-02 00:52): "followed the founder, Stephen Gaskin", and a last sentence that says the truth was Y, not X [in the section 3 v10 candidate]
entries.joel: [The Farm](https://thefarmcommunity.com/), in Tennessee, at its largest about 1,500 people, had many beautiful values. But in the early days, the community’s spirituality and social life followed the founder, Stephen Gaskin. From what former members have shared, the community’s doctrine ran deep into members’ intimate decisions. This is how it often goes: folks talk about oneness with the universe, while one man defines what the universe is.
must_contain: followed the founder, Stephen Gaskin.
This is how it often goes: folks talk about oneness with the universe, while one man defines what the universe is.
must_not_contain: It’s one thing to talk about a universal consciousness

entries.what: Section 3, P7: Joel's fix (2026-10-02 00:52: "emulate lost the meaning of the original") [in the section 3 v10 candidate, with his straight apostrophe]
entries.joel: The two failures mirror each other. Secular groups distribute power but leave the inner life largely private or ignored. Spiritual groups attempt to address the inner life, but because it's inner being shaped by outer as a condition of membership, we tend to find both real-world and spiritual power concentrating around whoever defines the path.
must_contain: The two failures mirror each other.
largely private or ignored
because it's inner being shaped by outer as a condition of membership
around whoever defines the path
must_contain_exact: because it's inner being shaped by outer

entries.what: Section 3, P9: Joel's fix (2026-10-02 00:52): he does want people to come in largely healed, without pretending they're finished; "where people don't come in pre-healed" said nearly the opposite [in the section 3 v10 candidate, with his straight apostrophes]
entries.joel: I dream of a way to work in depth that isn’t run by a guru, and a way of being in a community with distributed authority. A place where people who've done the healing first can join without pretending they're fully finished, and that also has peer practice and enough play that it doesn’t become a permanent repair shop.
